conflicts.detail: The overview and general education heading on printed page 115 say 13 competencies. The list on page 116 contains 16 distinct codes. All 16 listed requirements are retained, totaling 48 equivalent credits.

The ACCC 235 description recommends completing Accounting for Managerial Decisions (ACCC 240) first. ACCC 240 recommends completing Financial Planning and Control (ACCC 235) first. These instructions conflict. No required course sequence has been inferred.

CSCC 408 has a Database heading and outcome, followed by text about citing information resources for a research project. Its code and 3 credits are explicit. The mismatched paragraph does not establish further topic requirements.

The program list and competency descriptions use slightly different titles for COMC 410, CSCC 301 and MKTC 470. Both source titles are retained. Their identities are joined only by the exact course code within this catalog.
